blurb: This check verifies that every LDR_PRELOAD list in the global initialization files (/etc/profile, /etc/bashrc, /etc/security/.login, /etc/environment, /etc/security/environ) contains only absolute library paths or $PATH. A relative preload entry lets a process started from those files load a library from the current directory, so an attacker who can drop a library there injects code into any session that sources the file; an empty preload slot is equally invalid.
